subject: general
question: P, Q, R and S are facing north and A, B, C and D are facing them, not necessarily in the same order. S is sitting second to the right of R. The person who faces Q is not a neighbour of B. D is facing S and sitting next to B. A is sitting on an extreme position. P and C are not facing each other. R is at one end but C is not. Who is facing the person second to the right of Q?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R and S are facing north and A, B, C and D are facing them..

1) S is sitting second to the right of R.

2) The person who faces Q is not a neighbour of B.

3) D is facing S and sitting next to B.

4) A is sitting on an extreme position.

5) P and C are not facing each other.

6) R is at one end but C is not.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdc4c9b14b23430ed1d182e2b5748456715305f6046e2031b30bc80308fadff6.png] 

So, **B **is facing the person second to the right of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B".**
